rule: The latest explicit user instruction is authoritative. Retire V3-V6 and legacy adapters/workflows immediately; a temporary state with no operational champion is explicitly allowed. Do not retain or restore legacy code merely to satisfy stale validation assumptions. V7 remains PAPER-only and authenticated execution remains disabled.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, slippage, adverse markout, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: leave-targets-out factor basis, null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, phi^h forecast and PnL-unit hedge ratios; evaluate 30m and 60m separately
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons
model_contracts.micro_maker: optimize fill-conditioned net PnL, not fill probability; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity and adverse markout are required; exits/markouts are quantity-specific depth-aware
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; no product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities; explicit partial-state unwind; fixed-horizon executable liquidation for full and partial states; dependence-robust chronological inference
model_contracts.external_intelligence: fail closed; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved probability mapping and evidence

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence

Keep V7 PAPER authorization, hard safety, exact-SHA evidence and authenticated-execution separation intact.
